initiatives.title: Watauga Open Books
initiatives.summary: Pass the Lobbying Disclosure Act (HB-21): require every PAC active in Franklin to disclose its donors above a threshold. If a Cumberland or a Greater Watauga is shaping our votes, we should be able to see it. Sign to move HB-21 out of committee.
initiatives.legislative_vehicle: prop-hb21 (Reyes-Combs's bill is the vehicle; the initiative is the public pressure behind it).

initiatives.title: A Dog Park for the Riverwalk
initiatives.summary: Add a fenced dog park to the Riverwalk parks plan. Good for dogs, good for downtown. (Earnest, low-stakes — and it never reached the signature threshold before the window closed.)
initiatives.note: Expired below threshold — the honest 'not everything wins' case + the only local-scope initiative in the seed.
